title: Fix release workflow runner to fixed ubuntu-latest
rawUserRequest: 发布完成后，新开一个 WI，将除 CodeQL 外的 release 相关 Actions runner 固定为 ubuntu-latest，避免组织级 runner 路由消耗组织资源；保持 CodeQL 的现有专用配置不变。

declaredIntent.summary: Make the release workflow use the free standard ubuntu-latest hosted runner explicitly while preserving CodeQL and unrelated workflow runner choices.

outOfScope: Do not modify CodeQL configuration or any workflow other than the release workflow.
Do not change release evidence ordering, tag creation, public assets, installer behavior, or release metadata.
Do not create or alter self-hosted runner registration, organization billing, or runner-group settings.
Do not publish a new release solely for this workflow routing change unless separately authorized.

sources.reason: The release job currently resolves its runner through the organization variable AI_COCKPIT_RELEASE_RUNNER.
Workflow regression tests currently assert the configurable runner override and must lock the fixed runner contract.
Canonical English release operations documentation currently describes the runner override.
Japanese release operations documentation must describe the same fixed runner boundary.
Observed organization hosted-runner evidence identifies the current code-scanning runner as a standard Ubuntu Latest 24.04, 2-core hosted runner.

riskAssessment.reason: The release workflow runner selection changes future hosted execution routing; release behavior and other workflows must remain unchanged.

reasons: A single workflow routing change with explicit regression coverage is bounded but affects release execution.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly requested the bounded release runner routing change; no open contract unknowns remain.

preReviewWarnings: Only the release job may change; preserve CodeQL and all unrelated workflow runner assignments.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The release job in .github/workflows/release.yml uses the literal runs-on value ubuntu-latest and no longer reads AI_COCKPIT_RELEASE_RUNNER.
tests/test_release_workflow.py asserts the exact release runs-on line, asserts AI_COCKPIT_RELEASE_RUNNER is absent, and asserts no CodeQL or unrelated workflow path is changed.
docs/reference/distribution.md and docs/reference/distribution.ja.md state that the release job uses ubuntu-latest and no longer advertise AI_COCKPIT_RELEASE_RUNNER.
Release evidence ordering, publication steps, and all non-runner release behavior remain byte-for-byte unchanged outside the intended runner line and documentation/test assertions.
All governed checks and project quality checks pass with no test deletion, weakening, or unrelated workflow modification.
guidelines: Keep the change limited to the release workflow runner contract, its regression test, and aligned documentation.
Do not modify CodeQL or unrelated Actions runner selection.
Do not weaken or delete tests; add assertions that fail if the configurable release runner returns.
Do not claim billing savings as a measured fact unless provider billing evidence is available; describe runner routing and public-repository eligibility separately.

intent.problem: The release job currently resolves runs-on through AI_COCKPIT_RELEASE_RUNNER, which routes the public release workflow through an organization-level hosted runner label even though the release job only needs the standard Ubuntu runner.
constraints: Keep CodeQL and unrelated workflows unchanged.
Do not change release correctness, evidence, or publication behavior.
Use a literal standard hosted runner label so the release job cannot silently consume an organization-specific runner route.
intent.rationale: A fixed ubuntu-latest declaration removes the organization-level routing indirection at the source and a regression test prevents the override from being reintroduced.
